incident_text: Users report that portfolio balances look stale or fail to refresh since about 12:55. Sync errors are spiking.

truth.description: aa-sync exhausted its database connection pool (pool full, requests queued), making account-aggregator sync slow and error-prone and leaving portfolio data stale.

logs.msg: connection pool exhausted: {pool_in_use}/{pool_max} connections in use, requests queued

changes.note: UI copy change on holdings page

trap: unrelated UI deploy 10 minutes after the real onset
